# Pryara

> Submission-ready Expressions of Interest (EOIs) for consulting firms answering World Bank and AfDB Requests for
> Expressions of Interest (REOIs). Every claim traced to the firm's own records. USD 150 per EOI, paid in advance.

## What we do
- For one firm and one named REOI, in English: a criteria checklist, a claim → evidence table and the EOI in Word,
  set out in the REOI's own order and within its limits.
- Our AI tools research and draft. Francis Rotich, our founder, reviews every page in full before the firm sees it.
- The firm checks, signs and submits the EOI. We never contact the procuring entity. We do not promise shortlisting
  or a win.
- Free: name an open REOI and we send you its criteria checklist (every shortlisting criterion, format rule and the
  deadline, quoted from the notice). No obligation. Ask at pryara-eoi@agentmail.to.

## Terms
- USD 150 per EOI, paid in advance by card (USD) or by card or M-Pesa (KES), with an eTIMS invoice.
- At least 7 working days must remain before the REOI deadline. Delivery at least 3 working days before the deadline.
- One consolidated revision round included. Full refund if we miss the agreed date through our own fault.
- Not a fit: REOIs in a language other than English, fewer than 7 working days to the deadline, firms that cannot show
  proof of their past assignments.

## Who we are
Pryara is a trading name of Chess Digital Media Marketing, P.O. Box 17144-00100, Nairobi, Kenya. Francis Rotich worked
in public procurement in Kenya for 17 years (2004–2021), more than ten of them on World Bank-financed projects.

## Contact
